Game Overview

In Rat Arena, the core idea is straightforward: battle through intricate mazes in Rat Arena, confronting a vicious rat foe. Equip a magic wand, sword, and shield in a strategic blend of action and survival. Master timing and tactics to conquer the arena, uncover secrets, and emerge victorious in this pulse-pounding adventure.
